userDirectives.scope: All non-NORMAL hunt monsters except Big Seal; include raids
userDirectives.style: Preserve individual illustration style, composition, camera, pose flow, character placement, light and background density; redesign identities
userDirectives.appearance: Include East Asian and white characters; avoid uniform dark skin and faces
userDirectives.mechanics: Preserve skill performance, timing, targets, effects, patterns and rewards

entries.composition: Landscape 5:4 dynamic 2D cel-shaded action tableau. Enormous muscular fighter in middle with arms spread broadly across the canvas; foreshortened fists, blue-white shock fractures, rubble and thrown armored opponents below both sides. Courtyard structures behind, maximal force and readable muscular anatomy.

Landscape 5:4 crowded dynamic cel-shaded illustration, a bulky marauder at the center lunging forward with left arm raised, curling black vortex tendrils framing the whole body, pink-violet sparks and broken floor blocks in foreground, warm brown background.

Landscape 5:4 close action view, lunging swordsman crouched diagonally, massive blade foreshortened from upper-right to lower-left, green energy crawling along the blade and gray-blue curling gusts around the perimeter. Bold clean 2D cel shading.

Landscape 5:4 centered crouching swordsman, saber sweeping strongly from high left to low right, intense foreshortened weapon hand, circular orange sparks and pale blue wind clouds, warm ochre setting. Crisp cel-shaded anime action.

Tall 9:16 anime fantasy portrait down to the hips, standing swordsman turned three-quarters away looking back, upper arm toward camera, electric violet and blue-white coils fill backdrop, strong rimlight, luminous energetic rendering.

Tall 4:5 right-facing three-quarter shoulder/head close-up, largely grayscale drawing with intense red energy streaks across black space; fine etched highlights, flowing dark hair lit silver, dramatic serious expression.

Portrait 4:5 dynamic anime cel-shaded crouching draw-cut pose, camera slightly above, face tilted down focused, sword hilt near lower chest, huge blue-white zigzag lightning crosses foreground, dim warm wooden hall.

Tall 9:16 chest-to-thigh swordsman facing camera at three-quarter angle, forward hand and crossed diagonal blades dominate foreground, emerald-white wind arcs behind and in front, green-black backlight, graphic cel shading.

Tall 3:5 crouched rushing swordsman, forward-looking face in upper-right-middle, cloth flowing from lower body to upper left, circular ribbon of orange fire enclosing the figure, blue night forest verticals behind. Polished vivid anime linework and cel shading.

Tall 2:3 illustrated poster, full-body airborne robed dual-blade warrior centered with a diagonal twist, huge pale garments sweeping outward, large blade above and another crossing lower front, gold flat textured background and dark tree-branch silhouettes; elegant ink and cel shading.

Tall 9:16 dark close-up of black-clad assassin seen over shoulder, face lower center, hand lifting mask at upper right side of face; large muted red moon behind upper left, black negative space, understated red sparks. Clean restrained 2D anime illustration.

Tall 2:3 luminous fantasy illustration: elegant full-body white-clad figure below center, much larger mist portrait of the SAME new character at upper right, full moon upper left, violet-blue petals and flowing hair, stone garden foreground. Keep fine painterly anime detail and layered scale.

Tall 9:16 joyous airborne full-body anime figure in center, head thrown slightly back laughing, both arms wide, legs bent in a leap, storm clouds form an oval around him with opening sunlight at top, white-blue lightning and floating rocks. Vivid buoyant illustration.

Tall 9:16 low-angle thigh-up regal warrior in left-facing three-quarter profile, massive gold shoulder near camera, brilliant reflective gold armor and vertically levitating weapon silhouettes framing both sides against near-black space. Hard-edged luminous cel shading.

Tall 9:16 low-angle full-body small summoner in front of enormous blue luminous guardian, moon high right, rocky ground, mist and floating rubble. Blue spectral bloom with realistic volumetric light and crisp anime contours.

Tall 9:16 low-angle muscular warrior from thigh up, head small against vast blazing golden animal apparition above, one enormous arm near camera holding weapon down, deep burnt shadows and rich golden rimlight. Painterly cinematic anime.

Tall 9:16 low-angle full-body confident pirate captain planted on rock, one hand resting on upright saber hilt, long coat flares wide behind, red-orange energy explosion and embers, bold warm anime illustration.

Tall 9:16 waist-up attack portrait, young fighter lunging toward viewer, oversized metal forearm and hand foreshortened across front, face at upper center, crackling cyan lightning, warm bronze metal reflections and dark storm backdrop. Rich painterly anime detail.

Tall 9:16 mid-thigh-up swordsman viewed from left side turning his face toward camera, one hand poised on sheathed blade at waist, windswept hair trailing right, ember-red forest background, spare moody anime cel shading.

Tall 9:16 extreme foreshortened charging martial artist down low in frame, one knee and fist thrust toward camera, giant red fiery beast face filling upper half, floating stones, graphic red-black and amber anime energy.

Tall 9:16 full-body arms-folded commander in lower center, huge living-wood guardian and tall forest canopy above, emerald fireflies, foreground leaves and overgrown terraces. Expansive luminous painterly fantasy composition.

Tall 2:3 very tight frontal head-and-shoulder sinister grinning portrait, stark red-black graphic ink treatment with warm amber focal eyes, heavy black negative shadows. Preserve the intense ink-poster feeling and crop.

Tall 9:16 layered black-white-red ink poster: central upper-body figure from low three-quarter angle, two larger ghost portraits of the same new identity above, red moon behind shoulders, violent ink-like crimson appendages across lower foreground, small lonely silhouette bottom. Scratchy dark graphic atmosphere.

Tall 9:16 commanding frontal torso close-up, centered down-tilted stern face, sword hilt crossing lower center, stark scarlet-black palette and diagonal red slash filaments, forceful cel-shaded linework.

Tall 9:16 dynamic foreshortened crouching mage reaching open hand toward viewer, face upper right-middle, green concentric luminous background high center, black feather-like debris swirling throughout, diagonally tilted action energy. Lush neon-green anime rendering.

Tall 2:3 close dynamic waist-to-knee martial arts illustration, aggressive smiling fighter leaning forward, large clenched forward fist at lower right-middle, other fist pulled back, circular red-orange energy strips framing him, blue night moon and ruined street behind. Rich clean anime painting.

Tall 9:16 powerful muscular fighter from knees up, fists relaxed beside body, stern three-quarter face, burnt sunset rocky arena, crimson glowing motes. Crisp strong anime cel shading and rim lighting.

Tall 1:2 extreme close-up, giant foreshortened open hand reaching from lower front, calm centered face slightly tilted, warm orange rimlight on dark cloak, fine scratch-like highlights and black negative backdrop. Preserve commanding dramatic hand/face hierarchy.

Tall 1:2 close front-facing swordsman bust, face upper center, blade runs diagonal from left-middle to lower-right foreground, intense fire sweep below, warm glowing orange edge light and dark background. Detailed painted anime.

Tall 9:16 minimal high-key fantasy poster with huge pale cloudy negative space in upper half, solitary full-body black-clad swordsman small and right of center, grounded upright blade on his left, broken ivory tiles below, black torn ink mist spreading to right, tiny red accents. Fine grayscale painterly anime.

Tall 9:16 illustrated poster: full-body arms-folded commander below center on broken rock, massive blue spirit occupying upper background, gray rainstorm, scattered swords and smoke, slightly low camera. Crisp 2D fantasy anime with restrained cinematic depth.

Tall 2:3 epic dark-fantasy painted illustration, central full-body armored death monarch, both hands stacked on an upright frost sword pointed into icy rock, sweeping dark cloak, frozen gothic fortress behind, blue eye-level glow, moonlit snow and rich metal texture.

Tall 2:3 low-angle full-body commander centered foreground, long cyan energy sword down to lower-left ground, flowing dark cape, gigantic luminous ghost double behind upper-left, ruined spired architecture at right, blue magical storm. Detailed vivid anime illustration.
